verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a general-purpose managed-agent platform: YAML-configured agents, MCP servers such as Linear, custom tools, skills, subagents, connected machines and approvals. Nothing in the evidence shows its agents diagnosing a reported bug, editing code or delivering a fix. These are developer building blocks for constructing such a workflow, and the community remarks about running Claude Code from a phone describe a third-party agent, not Omnara's own capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent autonomously diagnose and fix a reported bug
